decisions.reason: As a distant and highly niche product that was only lightly presented and showed no visible follow-on development, it is more likely to fall below aspiration levels and have its resources redirected to the core lighting business.
This product fits the firm’s industrial lighting capabilities well and the 2019 LED replacement-kit extension signals results strong enough to justify continued commitment.
Because it was a relaunch of a previously popular product close to the established offer, it likely meets aspiration levels well enough to remain in the range.

Although still relatively new and without visible follow-up evidence, it is close to the core office-lighting business, so a large firm with some slack would more likely continue testing it than withdraw it immediately.
Its close fit with the firm’s main offer and launch as a multi-model premium line suggest a meaningful strategic commitment, making near-term withdrawal less likely.
